reattempt.reason: Complete missing grades of frozen first answers after an unclassified native execution failure; preserve the initial failure and unknown usage; replace no first answer or valid first grade.

tokens.note: Reported tokens are a lower bound: calls with unknown usage are counted as calls, not tokens. The original run did not complete and did not meet a known total budget.

holdout_eligibility.note: Statistical eligibility only; this report adopts and enables nothing.

adoption.reason: Baseline supplement only; it cannot authorize adoption or review eligibility.

artifact_scope: Capture reports retain synthetic alias-to-original source maps for owner-side grading. They are synthetic evaluation artifacts for owner review, not production privacy data or shareable results.
